items.title: Lubin-Tate de Rham presentation and local-global compatibility of analytic quaternionic Shimura completed cohomology
items.author: Zhenghui Li; Benchao Su; Zhixiang Wu
items.difficulty_reason: The primary local-global description requires perfectoid quaternionic Shimura uniformization, geometric Sen theory and differential operators, a compact-support Lubin-Tate cohomology product formula, de Rham complexes and Hecke eigenspaces. The full author construction/proof and original de Rham weight, irreducibility, tame level and quaternionic assumptions are retained, rather than counting the earlier elementary descent support lemma.

primary.label: complete original main local-global theorem and classical automorphic occurrence criterion

proof_spans.label: complete author analytic cohomology, differential operators, product formula, local representation and main proof with full descent appendix

contexts.label: complete original Galois, quaternionic Shimura and Lubin-Tate representation hypotheses and definitions
original comparison, proof roadmap, notation and companion results as uncounted context
